latestVersion.changelog: 5.16.0: opt-in ASI Strict Mode in the npm package (ASI_STRICT_MODE=audit or enforce; off by default, no behaviour change). Python skill scripts unchanged.

raw_record.summary: Local Python orchestration skill: multi-agent workflows via shared blackboard file, permission gating, token budget scripts, and persistent project context. The bundled Python scripts make no network calls and have zero third-party dependencies. The parent repository also contains a TypeScript engine (not included in this skill bundle).
